title: Mithun Chakraborty Undergoes Surgery in Kolkata to Remove Metal Plate From Earlier Injury
excerpt: The veteran Bollywood actor and BJP leader is in stable condition after the procedure, with West Bengal CM Suvendu Adhikari and actor Dev Adhikari visiting him in hospital.
body:
• Veteran Bollywood actor Mithun Chakraborty, 75, underwent successful surgery at a private hospital in Kolkata on Thursday to remove a metal plate implanted after an earlier injury.
  • West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari visited the hospital and confirmed the actor is in stable condition with no complications.
  • Actor and TMC politician Dev Adhikari also visited, calling Chakraborty "a father figure" in a heartfelt Instagram post.
  • The Dadasaheb Phalke Award recipient is expected to be discharged soon and will next appear in Rajinikanth's Jailer 2.

Successful Surgery at Kolkata Hospital

Veteran Bollywood actor and BJP leader Mithun Chakraborty underwent a successful surgical procedure at a private hospital in Kolkata on Thursday, according to Bollywood Hungama. The surgery was performed to remove a metal plate that had been implanted following an earlier injury.

Hospital sources confirmed that the procedure went smoothly and that Chakraborty is in stable condition with no complications reported. The actor remains under medical observation at the facility, with doctors monitoring his recovery.

Political Leaders Rally Around the Star

The hospitalisation drew immediate attention from political circles. West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari visited Chakraborty at the hospital and later posted an update on social media.

"Distinguished film actor and BJP central committee member Mithun Chakraborty has been admitted to a private hospital in Kolkata due to health issues. I visited the hospital today to see him. I spoke with him and enquired about his health condition. I pray to the Almighty God for his speedy recovery."

— Suvendu Adhikari, West Bengal Chief Minister

Actor and Trinamool Congress politician Dev Adhikari also visited the hospital, crossing party lines to check on the veteran star. He shared a photograph with Chakraborty on Instagram, writing: "You have always been like a father figure to me. Wishing you the best of health, happiness and everything you deserve."

The visits underscore Chakraborty's stature in both West Bengal's political and cultural landscape. Despite being affiliated with the BJP — which defeated the Trinamool Congress in the 2026 state assembly elections — the actor commands respect across party lines.

A Career Spanning Five Decades

Mithun Chakraborty, born Gouranga Chakraborty, has been one of Indian cinema's most enduring figures since his debut in the 1976 film Mrigayaa, which won him a National Film Award for Best Actor. His portrayal of Jimmy in the 1982 cult classic Disco Dancer made him a pan-Indian phenomenon and cemented his status as a cultural icon, particularly among diaspora audiences.

Over a career spanning more than five decades, Chakraborty has appeared in over 350 films across Hindi, Bengali, Odia, and Telugu cinema. He received the Dadasaheb Phalke Award, Indian cinema's highest honour, in 2024.

This is not the first health scare for the actor. In February 2024, he was hospitalised in Kolkata after being diagnosed with an ischemic cerebrovascular stroke. He recovered and was discharged within days, later attributing the episode to overeating, telling reporters: "I eat like a demon. So I was punished."

Active in Politics and Film

Beyond his film career, Chakraborty has been an active BJP leader in West Bengal. He campaigned extensively for the party during the 2026 Assembly elections, which saw the BJP come to power in the state. He is a member of the party's central committee and has expressed his commitment to overseeing the party's work across Bengal's 42 Lok Sabha constituencies.

On the professional front, Chakraborty is set to appear in Rajinikanth's much-anticipated sequel Jailer 2. His daughter Dishani Chakraborty recently got engaged to her longtime boyfriend Myles Mantzaris, with a wedding date already set, according to Bollywood Hungama.

Expected Discharge Soon

According to Inshorts, Chakraborty is expected to be discharged from the hospital soon. Further updates on his condition are anticipated as doctors continue to monitor his recovery. For now, the outpouring of support from across political and entertainment circles reflects the unique position Chakraborty holds in Indian public life.
